column2: Your guards drag [From.GetTitledFirstName] up the steps of the temple to the great brazen statue of Hashut at its peak. Beneath the idol a pool of molten metal serves as its furnace. As the temple's Bull Centaur sets [From.GetHerHim] at the edge of the pit, you hear [From.GetHerHim] mumble a prayer to [From.Religion.GetHighGodName].\n\nThe Bull Centaur looks to you, his hide, blessed by Hashut, untouched by the terrible heat. One nod from you and he will throw the offering into the furnace...

You watch gleefully as the Bull Centaurs drag [From.GetTitledFirstName] up the stairs of the ziggurat towards the great brazen statue of Hashut and the pool of molten metal beneath it. As they hold [From.GetHerHim] over the furnace, you hear the mumblings of a prayer to [From.Religion.GetHighGodName].\n\n[From.GetFirstName] tries to keep a stoic face... but it soon twists into agony as [From.GetSheHe] is lowered into the molten metal.
Mighty Hashut, we offer you this traitor, a servant of the Ancestor Gods!
Mighty Hashut, we offer you a lord of the [From.Culture.GetName]s!
Mighty Hashut, accept this weak [From.Culture.GetName] as sacrifice!
The monstrous Bull Centaur plunges you into the pool of molten metal. You scream as your skin melts away, and then you see nothing more...
Hashut take you all...

The acolytes of Hashut have readied the furnaces atop the ziggurat of [Root.Capital.GetName], chanting the sacred dirges. Now is the time to offer the souls of slaves and wretches to the Bullfather, so that Lord Hashut may feast on them.\n\nThe temple's Bull Centaurs look to you, ready to bring up the offering at your command...
Herd in the slaves from the factories!
Bring the wretches of our slave levies!
Our prisoners shall have the honour of the furnace!
I have changed my mind! Hashut deserves no gifts today!

You watch gleefully as the Bull Centaurs herd a mass of slaves up the stairs of the ziggurat towards the great brazen statue of Hashut and the pool of molten metal beneath it. Whimpers and pleas rise from the wretches as they are driven to the edge of the furnace.\n\nOne by one they are pushed in, their screams forming a wonderful choir...
Mighty Hashut! Accept the slave blood and slave flesh we offer you!

For too long the furnaces of [Root.Capital.GetName] have stood cold and empty. Four years have passed without a proper sacrifice to Hashut, and the Father of Darkness does not look kindly on those who forget his due. The priests mutter in the temple, and your vassals wonder aloud whether the Bullfather still favours you.
Drag a prisoner up to the furnace!
Feed him a factory's worth of slaves.
Feed him the wretches of the slave levy.
I'm sure the Bullfather doesn't mind...
The Bullfather is pleased with your offering. As it dissolves into the molten pit, a booming voice rolls out of the brazen idol's head, offering you gifts...
Grant me fiery K'daai servants to sear my enemies!
Mighty Hashut, bless me with your strength!
Great Hashut, touch my lands with your fire!
Bullfather, grant me greater dominion over the Winds!
The Bullfather must be pleased with you. As the offering dissolves into the molten pit, a daemonic creature of fire and iron surges out of it and kneels before you, pledging itself to your service.
Bend to my will, daemon!
As the offering sinks into the molten metal, a bellowing roar shakes the temple. Outside waits a Great Taurus, one of Hashut's most favoured beasts, its wings wreathed in infernal flame. It is yours!
I will soar on wings of fire!
The Bullfather is pleased. You watch as the molten metal twists into shapes and forms, showing you visions of yourself surrounded by power and riches!

The Bullfather is pleased. You watch as the molten metal twists into shapes and forms, showing you visions of yourself surrounded by power and riches! When the visions fade, a rune of black iron lies cooling at the edge of the pit, still smoking with Hashut's blood.
It will all be mine!
As the offering sinks into the molten pit, the booming voice of Hashut fills your head, praising you... his greatest [Root.GetSonDaughter]!
All will bow before me!
After the offering sinks into the molten pit, visions of yourself fill your mind... a crown of fire sits on your brow, burning... burning, until naught but ash remains...
Why? What is the meaning of this?!
As the offering sinks into the molten pit, you step closer to receive your gift... and a gush of molten metal sprays into your face!
AAAAGH!!
At last the offering dissolves into the molten pit... and the ritual chamber fills with a dire silence. The Bullfather has ignored your offering!
Hashut's balls!

As the last screams of the offering echo through the chamber, nothing seems to change. But when you step out of the ziggurat, a regiment of Bull Centaurs waits at its foot, ready to serve you! This is surely Father Hashut's providence!
Praise Hashut!

As the last screams of the offering echo through the chamber, a cloud of red smoke gathers in front of you. In a blink it flies at you and forces itself down your throat, and you pass out. When you wake, the acolytes tell you that you have earned Hashut's wrath, and indeed, you feel much weaker...
Curses!

Praise mighty Hashut! After all the sacrifices and all your servitude, the Bullfather has at last granted you the greatest of his gifts: dominion over the Winds of Magic! Soon the whole world will be under your yoke, for now you are one of the great masters of the Dawi Zharr, a Sorcerer-Prophet!
ALL FOR HASHUT!

Of late your toes and fingertips have begun to turn to black stone. There is no doubt: the dreaded Sorcerer's Curse has taken hold of you. You can still move on your own, but you have lost much of your ease, and your servants have begun to whisper that you are weak...

The Sorcerer's Curse has almost claimed your body. Everything below your chest has turned to black stone, and you can barely lift your arms. Your mind is still clear and your tongue still works, but everyone can see that you are no longer fit to rule, and many of your servants think you weak...

As the stone creeps over your face, you set it into a stern expression, knowing that your body will stand as a testament to Hashut's power along the highways to Zharr-Naggrund, beside the petrified Sorcerer-Prophets who came before you.
Curses!
Hashut's balls!
I go to the Bullfather...
The K'daai slowly takes form before you, a creature of magma and iron, half daemon and half raging fire. The circle holds, and the daemon is yours to command.
I am your master now.
Your ritual for [From.GetFirstName] was a success. You have bound a searing K'daai to [From.GetHerHim].
Excellent.

[dawizharr_raided_province.GetName] has been raided and burned to the ground by our great hosts, its pathetic people brought low before the might of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] and Father Hashut. Where shall we send our new slaves?

[dawizharr_raided_province.GetName] has been raided and burned to the ground by our great hosts. Most of our overseers are already on the road to [Root.Capital.GetName], herding the slaves we took in an earlier assault, but your own retinue can still drag off a few more...
They shall toil in the great factories of [Root.Capital.GetName]!
These wretches shall march in the hosts of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]!
Take what we can carry and burn the rest!
This scum is only fit for the furnace! Throw them to Hashut!

Our slave factories and levy pens may only stand in our capital holding, where the overseers can keep watch. The slave buildings found elsewhere in our lands have been torn down and their slaves herded in chains to [Root.Capital.GetName].
March them to the capital.
The slaves of the factories at [Root.Capital.GetName] are dying off: choking smoke, accidents at the forges, hunger and plain mismanagement have thinned their ranks.
Hashut's horns! We need more slaves...
The slave barracks at [Root.Capital.GetName] are emptying: choking smoke, brutal hobgoblin overseers, hunger and plain mismanagement have thinned the levy.
Hashut's horns! We need more slaves...
Fresh slaves have arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]. Where shall we put them to work?
To the factories!
To the slave levy!

A hobgoblin slave-master offers to take [From.GetTitledFirstName] off your hands for the markets of [Root.Capital.GetName]. Captives with skill fetch the best price, but in the end they are all worked to death in the mines and forges.
I'm sure this one will sell nicely...

Your wretched master, [From.GetTitledFirstName], has sold you in the slave markets of [From.Capital.GetName]. Everyone knows that to be sold into slavery by the Chaos Dwarfs is a sentence of death... and you can only curse your fate.
Curse you, [From.GetTitledFirstName]!

You have come to buy arms from the Chaos Dwarfs of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. [From.GetTitledFirstName] receives you at the gates of [From.Capital.GetName]: "Welcome to mighty [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName], [Root.Culture.GetName]! Which great creation of the Dawi Zharr do you wish to buy?"

You have come to buy arms from the Dwarfs of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. [From.GetTitledFirstName] receives you in the guild hall of [From.Capital.GetName]: "Welcome to [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName], [Root.Culture.GetName]. Dawi work is not cheap, but it is honest. What will you have?"
Arms and armour for my warriors!
A battery of your war machines!
I will buy nothing from you squat weaklings!
[From.GetTitledFirstName], a [From.Culture.GetName] of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName], has come to [Root.Capital.GetName] to buy weapons and armour from our forges for [From.GetHerHis] warriors.
[From.GetTitledFirstName], a [From.Culture.GetName] of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName], has come to [Root.Capital.GetName] to buy a battery of our war machines.
Very well! Make the goods ready!
No! I will sell nothing to a filthy [From.Culture.GetName]!

Now that you have chosen what to buy from the factories of [From.Capital.GetName], you must pay for it. The Chaos Dwarfs take gold or slaves: slaves from your own pits, a prisoner from your dungeon, or the people of your capital in chains.
Now that you have chosen what to buy from the guilds of [From.Capital.GetName], you must pay for it. The Dwarf engineers take gold and nothing else.
I will pay in gold!
The people of [Root.Capital.GetName] shall be my payment!
I will pay in slaves from my own pits!
Take a prisoner from my dungeon.
That's far too dear. Maybe next time.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has paid in gold. It is a poorer payment than slaves, but it will do.

Amusingly, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has chained up [From.GetHerHis] own people in [From.Capital.GetName] and sent them to us as slaves! The [From.Culture.GetName] slaves are in decent condition, fit to work in our factories or serve in our hosts.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has paid in slaves from [From.GetHerHis] pits. They are weary, taken from many lands and races, but still fit to work in our factories or serve in our hosts.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has paid with a prisoner from [From.GetHerHis] dungeon, delivered to us in chains.
It is enough. Ship the goods.

At last the Hellcannons you bought from [From.GetTitledFirstName] have arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]! Daemon-bound engines of terrible power, they come with a regiment of Chaos Dwarf handlers to make sure the daemons inside never turn on their masters.

The Chaos-forged weapons and armour you bought from [From.GetTitledFirstName] have arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName], along with a great black shield for you. Your warriors are arming themselves already, and woe to anyone who stands against them!

At last the battery you bought from [From.GetTitledFirstName] has arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]: Dwarf cannons and Organ Guns, with a regiment of Dwarf warriors and Engineers to crew and guard them.
The weapons and armour you bought from [From.GetTitledFirstName] have arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]! Your soldiers are arming themselves with the finest steel of the Karaks.
Mighty devices indeed!
We will be unstoppable!
A level of slave factory is added to the capital holding.
A level of slave levy barracks is added to the capital holding.
The capital holding's slave factory loses a level.
The capital holding's slave levy barracks loses a level.
Up to five courtiers of the raided court are dragged off as prisoners.
Up to five courtiers of the raided court are thrown into Hashut's furnaces.
A prisoner from your dungeon is handed over in chains.
A battery of war machines and its guard regiment wait at your capital.
Hellforged Greatshield

A tower shield of black iron cast in the forges of Zharr-Naggrund, its boss a snarling bull's head. The Dawi Zharr send one with every arms deal, so that their customers remember where their strength comes from.
